name: FieldTicketAfeCoder
tagline: Code, price-check and approve oil & gas field tickets against AFE budgets – in one drop-in app.
description: A complete field-spend app for Power Apps and Power Pages: code service tickets to AFE, cost element and well with smart suggestions, validate every rate against the supplier price book, approve clean low-value tickets in bulk, run disputes with suppliers through to credit or rebill, and watch AFE spend vs budget before it reaches accounts payable.
features: Inline AFE / cost element / well coding with suggestions from supplier history and the well's open AFE
Bulk coding bar and 'Code with suggestions' per ticket
Price check vs supplier price book with tolerance %
Approve all clean (quick-approve limit) and approval-limit second approver
Dispute workflow with reason categories, response due dates, revised rates and late-reply alerts
AFE spend vs budget with cost-element breakdown, overrun tolerance, supplements and close-out
CSV export, delete with undo, grouping, paging
Demo mode with fictional data, phone layout with bottom bar
